summary: Transaction detail report batch. Reads a date range from a parameter file, then reads the transaction file and prints only transactions whose processing date falls in that range. Enriches each line with the account (via card cross-reference), transaction-type and transaction-category descriptions, and produces a formatted report with page headers, per-account (per-card) subtotals, page totals and a grand total via control-break logic.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open all files and read the reporting start/end dates from the date-parameter file. Loop reading the transaction file: skip any transaction whose processing date is outside the start..end range. For an in-range transaction, display it; when the card number changes, write the previous card's account totals (unless first time) and look up the new card's cross-reference. Look up the transaction type and category descriptions, then write the detail report line. At end-of-file, add the last amount to the running totals and write page totals and grand totals. Close all files and return.
branches: IF TRAN-PROC-TS date within WS-START-DATE..WS-END-DATE (else NEXT SENTENCE = skip)

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: only transactions with processing date between the parameter start and end dates are reported.
Control-break on card number produces per-account subtotals.

paragraphs.name: 0550-DATEPARM-READ
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the date-parameter record to obtain the reporting start and end dates; display the range. EOF sets end-of-file; other errors abend.
branches: IF APPL-AOK ... ELSE IF APPL-EOF ... ELSE abend

paragraphs.name: 1000-TRANFILE-GET-NEXT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the next transaction; EVALUATE status: '00' ok, '10' end-of-file, other error/abend.
branches: IF APPL-AOK ... ELSE IF APPL-EOF ... ELSE abend

paragraphs.name: 1100-WRITE-TRANSACTION-REPORT
paragraphs.pseudocode: On the first line, write the report headers with the date range. Every full page (line count reaches page size) write page totals and fresh headers. Add the transaction amount to the page and account running totals, then write the detail line.
branches: IF MOD(line-counter, page-size) = 0 -> page totals + headers

annotations.note: Pagination: uses FUNCTION MOD(line-counter, page-size) to trigger page breaks.

paragraphs.name: 1110-WRITE-PAGE-TOTALS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Write the page total line, roll the page total into the grand total, reset the page total, and re-emit the column header.

paragraphs.name: 1120-WRITE-ACCOUNT-TOTALS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Write the per-account (per-card) total line, reset the account total, and re-emit the column header.

paragraphs.name: 1110-WRITE-GRAND-TOTALS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Write the grand-total line at the end of the report.

paragraphs.name: 1120-WRITE-HEADERS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Write the report title and column-header lines.

paragraphs.name: 1120-WRITE-DETAIL
paragraphs.pseudocode: Format and write a single transaction detail line (id, date, description, type/category descriptions, amount).

paragraphs.name: 1111-WRITE-REPORT-REC
paragraphs.pseudocode: Write one physical record to the report file; abend on error.

paragraphs.name: 1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF
paragraphs.pseudocode: Look up the card in the cross-reference to resolve its account id for the report.

paragraphs.name: 1500-B-LOOKUP-TRANTYPE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Look up the transaction-type description for the report.

paragraphs.name: 1500-C-LOOKUP-TRANCATG
paragraphs.pseudocode: Look up the transaction-category description for the report.

paragraphs.name: 0000-TRANFILE-OPEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open the transaction file for input; abend on failure.

paragraphs.name: 0100-REPTFILE-OPEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open the report output file; abend on failure.

paragraphs.name: 0200-CARDXREF-OPEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open the card cross-reference file; abend on failure.

paragraphs.name: 0300-TRANTYPE-OPEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open the transaction-type reference file; abend on failure.

paragraphs.name: 0400-TRANCATG-OPEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open the transaction-category reference file; abend on failure.

paragraphs.name: 0500-DATEPARM-OPEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open the date-parameter file; abend on failure.

paragraphs.name: 9000-TRANFILE-CLOSE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Close the transaction file; abend on failure.

paragraphs.name: 9100-REPTFILE-CLOSE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Close the report file; abend on failure.

paragraphs.name: 9200-CARDXREF-CLOSE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Close the cross-reference file; abend on failure.

paragraphs.name: 9300-TRANTYPE-CLOSE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Close the transaction-type file; abend on failure.

paragraphs.name: 9400-TRANCATG-CLOSE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Close the transaction-category file; abend on failure.

paragraphs.name: 9500-DATEPARM-CLOSE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Close the date-parameter file; abend on failure.

paragraphs.name: 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
paragraphs.pseudocode: Set abend code 999 and call CEE3ABD to force an abnormal end.

paragraphs.name: 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Format and display the file status code, handling VSAM extended (9nn) codes.
branches: IF IO-STATUS NOT NUMERIC OR IO-STAT1 = '9' ... ELSE
